A malformed data URI with extract_images enabled produces an ImageExtractionFailed warning

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_images\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Text<img src=\"data:BADMIME\" alt=\"broken\">end</p>", options)
    println(result.content)
    println(result.warnings)
}
```
